wordingCorrection.before: CLI `trust review|approve|revoke` replaces 09's `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` stub end-to-end against a real supervisor in a tmp dir.
wordingCorrection.after: CLI `trust review|approve|revoke` replaces 09's `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` stub end-to-end, in a tmp dir. No supervisor participates: `trust *` has no supervisor path at all — its backend is a local on-disk capability store plus an in-process HMAC minter, per 09's own recorded decision that the minter is legitimately in-process-scoped (docs/evidence/phase-09/README.md, "#6 approval-token cross-process durability"). The absence is asserted rather than assumed: trust-dispatch.test.ts:41-43 supplies a `connectClient` that throws, and all three commands still return EXIT_OK.

criteria.notes: The "against a real supervisor" phrase is inherited from this phase's own §Test plan, which introduces it as "(mirrors 09's own convention)" rather than as a property of `trust *`. The correction is more precise, not weaker: the guarantee the box carries — the argv command reaches the real backend end-to-end in a tmp dir instead of the stub, and the shipped binary wires it — is fully evidenced above. Original wording preserved verbatim in the phase file, per the wording protocol.
